description: This file provides utility functions and classes for handling DNS names, including validation, conversion between dotted and network formats, canonicalization, and comparison.

classes.name: DomainNameComparator
classes.description: A comparator class for comparing DNS domain names in a case-insensitive manner, supporting both dotted and wire formats.

methods.name: IsValidDnsName
methods.description: Checks if a dotted DNS name is valid according to DNS naming rules.

methods.name: IsValidDnsRecordName
methods.description: Checks if a dotted DNS name is valid and suitable for DNS record use, excluding IP addresses and localhost.

methods.name: DottedNameToNetwork
methods.description: Converts a dotted DNS name to its network wire format representation.

methods.name: NetworkToDottedName
methods.description: Converts a network wire format DNS name to dotted string format.

methods.name: UrlCanonicalizeNameIfAble
methods.description: Attempts to canonicalize a name as a URL hostname; returns the original name if not possible.
